events.sourceLabel: Qualcomm official September 8 AWS AI data-center collaboration announcement
events.basis: Qualcomm Technologies and Amazon announced on September 8, 2026 a multigeneration collaboration on AWS custom AI-inference silicon and optical connectivity using Qualcomm SerDes and optical DSP technology, including designs extending up to 1.6T. This is an announced collaboration, NOT verified delivered hardware, contracted volumes, booked revenues or a dated production ramp.
events.importance: AWS custom inference silicon opportunity for Qualcomm; optical interconnect and data-center bandwidth roadmaps; distinguish potential future commercial production from announcement.
